tutorial_1: Till, plant, water, harvest, sell, buy better tools. Click a grass tile to dig.
tutorial_3: Click the house and take seeds in hand.
tutorial_4: You only carry one item. Plant the seeds.
tutorial_6: A plant is thirsty. Pick up the bucket ({n} L), fill it at the pump, water the plant.
tutorial_7: Something is ripe. Pick it, then pick another — the same fruit stacks in your hand.
tutorial_8: Drop it at the truck and Sell all.
tutorial_9: That's the tour. You're on your own.
